objective: Test whether a prioritized, candidate-limited, airlocked glyph-inspection tool improves ambiguous-character decisions without the distraction or unsolicited classifier labels observed in v2.
hypothesis: Limiting the agent to eight highest-impact disputed cells and returning classifier evidence only for literal alternatives it already proposed will preserve crop-local autonomy while meeting deterministic and blinded quality gates against toolbelt6.1.

design_changes_from_v2: hard per-page inspect_glyph ceiling reduced from 20 to 8
agent must supply at least two literal alternatives it already considered
tool result no longer exposes the classifier's unsolicited top-k characters
selected crop remains inline and the bulk manifest remains outside readable roots

ordering_expectation.geometry_gate: baseline and challenger two_layer classifications equal the exact five-case set
ordering_expectation.single_layer_gate: triggered and adopted are false on all 19 single-layer challenger outputs
ordering_expectation.two_layer_transition_gate: if challenger reorder is triggered then adopted is true and seq_ratio_after is greater than seq_ratio_before; adoption without trigger is forbidden
ordering_expectation.rationale: Triggering depends on the session draft. The invariant is auditable without incorrectly requiring a repair when the draft already has acceptable order.

development_scope.downstream_probe: Identity-blind Gemini answer-recovery judge on all paired outputs.

prior_evidence_disposition.v1: methodologically inconclusive; full fanout stopped and excluded
prior_evidence_disposition.v2: airlock correct but smoke rejected on frozen recall-delta gate

non_goals: No production recipe, suite, case, gold, prompt, proposal, promotion, or station socket changes.
No direct classifier write or unsolicited classifier character proposal.
No qualification claim from this development-only suite.
stop_conditions: Stop before remaining cases unless every v3 smoke gate is true.
Stop before the next paid dispatch if cumulative spend is unknown or can exceed 26 USD.
Preserve every terminal and incomplete record under its original identity.

amendments.reason: The six-case v3 smoke passed every declared deterministic, autonomy, ordering, identity, failure, and cost gate.
amendments.effect: The remaining eighteen declared cases were authorized under the unchanged identities and 12.3 USD full-development ceiling.

amendments.reason: The MTH1200 chunk preserved one frozen-baseline 900-second timeout and stopped before its sixth case. A new run completed the timed-out case and the undispatched case without changing either candidate.
amendments.effect: Use the recovery pair for the 24-case quality aggregate, retain the timeout as one catastrophic failure, and retain both immutable reports. Known full-development execution spend including partial timeout telemetry is 11.738219 USD, below the 12.3 USD ceiling; the interrupted in-flight request remains unknown.

next_permitted_action: Run and fully score the six-case v3 smoke under a new run ID; no remaining case may dispatch until every smoke gate passes.
